sections.changelog:
Changed

  • Settings page title and sidebar menu item now use the short name «Child Pages», matching the other MVweb plugins
  • Plugin display names (menu item, settings brand, hub card) are left in English like the other MVweb plugins — only descriptions and UI strings are translated to Russian
  • Rewrote the shortcode attribute descriptions in the Help tab to be more user-friendly (explain what each attribute does, not just list values)
